new_behaviors: Task forms/CSV importer, safe DOM text rendering, report/config export, explicit synthetic badge, current-input invalidation and delayed-result generation guard. Bundled app/guide is served locally.
actual_browser_and_docker: Release manager performs these separate local gates; not inferred from in-process tests.
limits: No authentication, durable history or multiuser controls.
Analytical methods are deterministic heuristics; not certification or complete AI/model automation.
CSV type suggestions use an eight-row preview and require review.
Browser print export uses the native print dialog.
publication: No commit, push or repository recreation performed by this developer.

concurrency_fix.scope: Preview API/fetch/JSON, paired previews, CSV and configuration file reads, and synthetic-example final provenance. Revision checks precede every async commit; superseded work never re-dirties or labels newer input.
concurrency_fix.test_type: Real application handlers imported into a small DOM fixture, with deliberately deferred API/file reads. This is not a claim of actual browser-level verification.

csv_missing_record_fix: Only physical blank lines (reader empty list) are skipped. Explicit empty records are preserved for row counts, schema diagnostics and required-field validation. All five independent CSV regressions pass in each of the three apps.
